DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.gov.ph OILG OPINION NO. HON. JOHN M. DALIPE Mayor, Zamboanga City Hall W33G+JFW, NS Valderosa St., Zamboanga, Zamboanga del Sur Dear Hon. Dalipe: This has reference to your letter dated June 2, 2023 and Resolution No. 784 of Sangguniang Panlungsod of Zamboanga City seeking legal opinion from this Department on whether the Barangay Tanods may be allowed to carry firearms under existing laws, rules and regulations. Please be advised that this Department has consistently maintained its position that barangay tanods and other members of so-called "police auxiliary units" (PAU) are not permitted by law to carry guns while performing official duties and functions. We reiterate that Republic Act No. 10591, or the Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act, enacted in 2012, revoked the authority of police auxiliary units, including barangay tanods, to carry firearms, which was previously allowed by NAPOLCOM Circular 2008-013. Section 5.5.2 of the Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of R.A. 10591 specifically provides: "Registered firearms of the LGUs and GOCCs covered by the Long Certificate of Registration shall only be issued to a government official or employee with a permanent plantilla position through the Short Certificate of Registration issued by the FEO. The officer representing the LGU or GOCC must possess the standard requirements mentioned in paragraphs 4.1 and 4.4." (Emphasis supplied) Further, DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2003-42, dated 10 March 2003 specifically provides for the equipage/gadgets of the barangay tanods, to wit: • Nightsticks with teargas Handcuff with holster Whistle Flashlight Raincoat Rainboots "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Small notebooks and pens First Aid Kits Thus, you are likewise reminded of DILG MC No. 2018-18, dated 8 February 2018 regarding the implementation of certain provisions of R.A. No. 10591 in relation to NAPOLCOM opinion revoking the authority of Barangay Tanods to carry firearms. While barangay tanods are very useful in assisting the local authorities in the maintenance of peace and order, we regret to inform you that under existing regulations, barangay tanods cannot be armed with firearms.l Finally, we are of the view that barangay tanods can always seek the assistance of local police or other barangay tanods in case they believe that they are in a potentially dangerous position. The opinion of this Department is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated in your letter and our appreciation of the same. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AT ORITY OF THE SECRETARY: UAN VI OR R.
